front_matter.preface: Pa o Kamata Isha mai Jesu Christawui Khararchan: John Kahona Kasa (The Gospel According to St. John in Tangkhul Naga), translated from the original Greek by Rev. William Pettigrew. Published in London by the British and Foreign Bible Society in 1904; printed at the Baptist Mission Press, Calcutta. This landmark volume represents the first printed continuous scripture portion in the Tangkhul Naga language in the Ukhrul dialect.

chapters.title: Kaphung-kachungwui Tui (The Word in the Beginning)
chapters.summary: The prologue to St. John: The Word was with God, life, light, and the testimony of John the Baptist.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Kaphung-kachungwui thotli Tui li-li-sai, kala Tuichi Varivarali lei, kala Tuichi Varivarasai. Chiya kaphung-kachungli Varivarawui kachungli leisai. Ali vangteina ot kathata pamei sakahaisai; Awui chungli haring kasawui maram leisai; kala haring chi miwungwui khanganaso thotsai. Kala Tuichi miwung thot sakahaida i-wui ngachaili pamsai; kala i-thumna Awui mashunkashak theisai.
chapters.english_translation: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made by Him. In Him was life, and the life was the light of men. And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, full of grace and truth.
chapters.grammar_notes: The copula clitic '-sai' signifies remote past narrative, while '-na' marks divine nominative agency.

exercises.question: How did Pettigrew translate 'the Word' (Logos) in Tangkhul?
Explain the semantic adaptation of 'Varivara' for the Supreme Deity.

chapters.title: Cana Ramli Phankahai Thot (The Marriage in Cana)
chapters.summary: The first sign in Cana of Galilee: turning water into wine and the cleansing of the Temple in Jerusalem.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Thot thumana phungli Galilee ramwui Cana shongli phankahai thotli amina pamsai; Jesu kala Awui ngashunbingli chili ho-ngarursai. Jesuna athumli hosa: Tuisin hili tara kaping zang-chihailu. Kala athumna ngathumda kaping zangsai. Phankahai wui pamshim-khararna tara chi khamarao kasada theiphun chitharan, kashak maram mathangsa mana. Kala Varivarawui shimli A se-bing kala tangka kakhalimbingi theida shim katharawui pammali khor-khaleisai.
chapters.english_translation: On the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus and His disciples were invited. Jesus said unto them: Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them to the brim. When the ruler of the feast tasted the water that was made wine, he knew not whence it was. And in the temple He found those that sold oxen and sheep, and drove them out of the holy place.

vocabulary.meaning: governor of the feast, master of ceremonies

chapters.grammar_notes: Prefix 'ka-' with stative stem '-ping' (full) forms the participial modifier 'kaping' (completely full).

exercises.question: Where did the first miracle take place in Tangkhul?
What Tangkhul phrase translates 'filled to the brim'?

chapters.title: Nicodemusli Tui Kaphung (Discourse with Nicodemus)
chapters.summary: Discourse on spiritual rebirth from above, the work of the Spirit, and the love of God for the world.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Phariseebingwui ngachaili Nicodemus kahona mi akhat pamsai, aya Judea miwungwui khararsai. Jesuna ngahanda hosa: Kaphung-kachangli Ina nali hosa, mi akhatna thot katharada mazat-khalakha Varivarawui kazingram theikhami mathailak mana. Kha Varivarana ngalei hiwui miwungli kongashi-kasa thotna, Amani Makaza Mayarwui khali ngashir-khami, chiya Ali kachithek phungmei khikha masiman-lakla, kashak thotwui haring kazang pamsai.
chapters.english_translation: There was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews. Jesus answered: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God. For God so loved the world, that He gave His only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in Him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

vocabulary.meaning: new birth, born again, regenerated life
to love tenderly, divine agape love

chapters.grammar_notes: Conditional suffix '-khalakha' (unless / except) governs the subjunctive negative verbal stem 'mazat-'.

exercises.question: Translate John 3:16 from Tangkhul into English.
Identify the theological terms used for 'heaven' and 'everlasting life'.

chapters.title: Samaria Shanawui Tui (The Samaritan Woman at the Well)
chapters.summary: Jesus at Jacob's well in Sychar of Samaria: living water and worshipping God in spirit and truth.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Jesu zattangda Jacobwui tuikhor ngalenli pamsai. Samaria shanawui akhatna tara khaphungli rasai; Jesuna ali hosa: Ili tara mangkhami khalu. Ina khami tara khamang chi thangmatharada khangaraophung mapamlik mana; kha Ina khami tara chi awui chungli kashak thotwui haring kaphanwui tuikhor thot salikha. Varivaraya Mangan thotsai; kala Ali khangamorbingna Mangan kala Kashungli khangamor kashungsa.
chapters.english_translation: Jesus sat thus on the well of Jacob. There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink. Whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life. God is a Spirit: and they that worship Him must worship Him in spirit and in truth.
chapters.grammar_notes: The dual case postposition 'kala' pairs 'Mangan' (Spirit) and 'Kashung' (Truth) as twin coordinates.

exercises.question: Where was the well located according to the text?
What is the requirement for true worshippers stated in John 4:24?

chapters.title: Bethesda Tuikhorli Thotkhamatei (Healing at Bethesda)
chapters.summary: Healing of the infirm man of thirty-eight years at Bethesda on the Sabbath and discourse on divine authority.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Jerusalemli sayat kachung khami gate wui pammali Bethesda kahona tuikhor pamsai. Chili kum thumchitaruk kachang kazat akhatna pamsai; Jesuna ali theida hosa: Nana kaphara phasasholakha? Jesuna ali hosa: Ngakaranglu, nawui khamathali phunglu kala zatlu! Kaphung-kachangli Ina nithumli hosa, Iwui tui kakhangasho kala Ili kasobingli kachithekna kashak thotwui haring leisai, kala thikahaiwui ngachaili haringli kaphan theisai.
chapters.english_translation: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool called Bethesda. A certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years. Jesus saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole? Rise, take up thy bed, and walk! Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and is passed from death unto life.
chapters.grammar_notes: Imperative suffix '-lu' forms strong commands: 'ngakaranglu' (arise!), 'phunglu' (take up!), 'zatlu' (walk!).

exercises.question: For how many years was the man infirm at Bethesda?
What three commands did Jesus give the healed man?

chapters.title: Raruikatha Kachiwui Paothem (The Bread of Life)
chapters.summary: Feeding of the multitudes and declaration: I am the living bread that came down from heaven.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Jesuna athumli hosa: Ina haringwui raruikatha thotsai; Iwui kachungli khara chi thangmatharada kharashok mapamlik mana; kala Ili kachithek chi thangmatharada khangaraophung mapamlik mana. Simon Peterna ngahanda hosa: O Mapao, ithumna khipalishong zatta katha? Nawui kachungli kashak thotwui tui pamsai. Kala ithumna chitheksai kala theisai Nana Varivarawui Kathara chi thotsai.
chapters.english_translation: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst. Simon Peter answered Him, Lord, to whom shall we go? Thou hast the words of eternal life. And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
chapters.grammar_notes: Double negative particle 'mapamlik mana' emphasizes categorical impossibility: shall never ever hunger.

exercises.question: What title did Simon Peter confess in John 6:69?

chapters.title: Haring Tara Kong (Rivers of Living Water)
chapters.summary: The proclamation at the Feast of Tabernacles: rivers of living water flowing from within.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Phanitwui thang kashung chili Jesu ngakarangda kaho: Mi akhatna khangaraokhalakha Iwui kachungli rada manglu. Ili kachithekna, tui katharali kakashitheithata, awui malungli haring tara kong shokkasa pamsai. Kha Aya Manganwui maram hosa, chiya Ali kachithekna khapan kashung thotsai.
chapters.english_translation: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink. He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water. But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive.

vocabulary.meaning: flowing forth, welling up from within
unto, toward, into the presence of

chapters.grammar_notes: The compound noun 'tara kong' combines 'tara' (water) and 'kong' (river/stream) denoting an abundant torrent.

exercises.question: What promise is given to believers in John 7:38?
What does 'malung' symbolize in Tangkhul psychology?

lines: CHAPTER 1: KAPHUNG-KACHUNGWUI TUI (THE WORD IN THE BEGINNING)
Summary: The prologue to St. John: The Word was with God, life, light, and the testimony of John the Baptist.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Kaphung-kachungwui thotli Tui li-li-sai, kala Tuichi Varivarali lei,

leisai. Ali vangteina ot kathata pamei sakahaisai; Awui chungli haring

Tuichi miwung thot sakahaida i-wui ngachaili pamsai; kala i-thumna Awui
mashunkashak theisai.

was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made by

grace and truth.

pages.header: Chapter 2: Cana Ramli Phankahai Thot (The Marriage in Cana) (Page 7)
pages.title: Chapter 2: Cana Ramli Phankahai Thot (The Marriage in Cana)
lines: CHAPTER 2: CANA RAMLI PHANKAHAI THOT (THE MARRIAGE IN CANA)
Summary: The first sign in Cana of Galilee: turning water into wine and the cleansing of the Temple in Jerusalem.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Thot thumana phungli Galilee ramwui Cana shongli phankahai thotli amina
pamsai; Jesu kala Awui ngashunbingli chili ho-ngarursai. Jesuna athumli
hosa: Tuisin hili tara kaping zang-chihailu. Kala athumna ngathumda
kaping zangsai. Phankahai wui pamshim-khararna tara chi khamarao kasada
theiphun chitharan, kashak maram mathangsa mana. Kala Varivarawui shimli
A se-bing kala tangka kakhalimbingi theida shim katharawui pammali khor-
khaleisai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
On the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus and His
disciples were invited. Jesus said unto them: Fill the waterpots with
water. And they filled them to the brim. When the ruler of the feast
tasted the water that was made wine, he knew not whence it was. And in
the temple He found those that sold oxen and sheep, and drove them out
of the holy place.

pages.header: Chapter 3: Nicodemusli Tui Kaphung (Discourse with Nicodemus) (Page 10)
pages.title: Chapter 3: Nicodemusli Tui Kaphung (Discourse with Nicodemus)
lines: CHAPTER 3: NICODEMUSLI TUI KAPHUNG (DISCOURSE WITH NICODEMUS)
Summary: Discourse on spiritual rebirth from above, the work of the Spirit, and the love of God for the world.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Phariseebingwui ngachaili Nicodemus kahona mi akhat pamsai, aya Judea
miwungwui khararsai. Jesuna ngahanda hosa: Kaphung-kachangli Ina nali
hosa, mi akhatna thot katharada mazat-khalakha Varivarawui kazingram
theikhami mathailak mana. Kha Varivarana ngalei hiwui miwungli kongashi-
kasa thotna, Amani Makaza Mayarwui khali ngashir-khami, chiya Ali
kachithek phungmei khikha masiman-lakla, kashak thotwui haring kazang
pamsai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
There was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
Jesus answered: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born
again, he cannot see the kingdom of God. For God so loved the world,
that He gave His only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in Him
should not perish, but have everlasting life.

pages.header: Chapter 4: Samaria Shanawui Tui (The Samaritan Woman at the Well) (Page 13)
pages.title: Chapter 4: Samaria Shanawui Tui (The Samaritan Woman at the Well)
lines: CHAPTER 4: SAMARIA SHANAWUI TUI (THE SAMARITAN WOMAN AT THE WELL)
Summary: Jesus at Jacob's well in Sychar of Samaria: living water and worshipping God in spirit and truth.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Jesu zattangda Jacobwui tuikhor ngalenli pamsai. Samaria shanawui
akhatna tara khaphungli rasai; Jesuna ali hosa: Ili tara mangkhami
khalu. Ina khami tara khamang chi thangmatharada khangaraophung mapamlik
mana; kha Ina khami tara chi awui chungli kashak thotwui haring
kaphanwui tuikhor thot salikha. Varivaraya Mangan thotsai; kala Ali
khangamorbingna Mangan kala Kashungli khangamor kashungsa.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
Jesus sat thus on the well of Jacob. There cometh a woman of Samaria to
draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink. Whosoever drinketh
of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water
that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into
everlasting life. God is a Spirit: and they that worship Him must
worship Him in spirit and in truth.

pages.header: Chapter 5: Bethesda Tuikhorli Thotkhamatei (Healing at Bethesda) (Page 15)
pages.title: Chapter 5: Bethesda Tuikhorli Thotkhamatei (Healing at Bethesda)
lines: CHAPTER 5: BETHESDA TUIKHORLI THOTKHAMATEI (HEALING AT BETHESDA)
Summary: Healing of the infirm man of thirty-eight years at Bethesda on the Sabbath and discourse on divine authority.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Jerusalemli sayat kachung khami gate wui pammali Bethesda kahona tuikhor
pamsai. Chili kum thumchitaruk kachang kazat akhatna pamsai; Jesuna ali
theida hosa: Nana kaphara phasasholakha? Jesuna ali hosa: Ngakaranglu,
nawui khamathali phunglu kala zatlu! Kaphung-kachangli Ina nithumli
hosa, Iwui tui kakhangasho kala Ili kasobingli kachithekna kashak
thotwui haring leisai, kala thikahaiwui ngachaili haringli kaphan
theisai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool called Bethesda. A
certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
Jesus saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole? Rise, take up thy bed,
and walk! Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and
believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and is passed from
death unto life.

pages.header: Chapter 6: Raruikatha Kachiwui Paothem (The Bread of Life) (Page 17)
pages.title: Chapter 6: Raruikatha Kachiwui Paothem (The Bread of Life)
lines: CHAPTER 6: RARUIKATHA KACHIWUI PAOTHEM (THE BREAD OF LIFE)
Summary: Feeding of the multitudes and declaration: I am the living bread that came down from heaven.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Jesuna athumli hosa: Ina haringwui raruikatha thotsai; Iwui kachungli
khara chi thangmatharada kharashok mapamlik mana; kala Ili kachithek chi
thangmatharada khangaraophung mapamlik mana. Simon Peterna ngahanda
hosa: O Mapao, ithumna khipalishong zatta katha? Nawui kachungli kashak
thotwui tui pamsai. Kala ithumna chitheksai kala theisai Nana
Varivarawui Kathara chi thotsai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me
shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
Simon Peter answered Him, Lord, to whom shall we go? Thou hast the words
of eternal life. And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ,
the Son of the living God.

pages.header: Chapter 7: Haring Tara Kong (Rivers of Living Water) (Page 19)
pages.title: Chapter 7: Haring Tara Kong (Rivers of Living Water)
lines: CHAPTER 7: HARING TARA KONG (RIVERS OF LIVING WATER)
Summary: The proclamation at the Feast of Tabernacles: rivers of living water flowing from within.
TANGKHUL READING TEXT:
Phanitwui thang kashung chili Jesu ngakarangda kaho: Mi akhatna
khangaraokhalakha Iwui kachungli rada manglu. Ili kachithekna, tui
katharali kakashitheithata, awui malungli haring tara kong shokkasa
pamsai. Kha Aya Manganwui maram hosa, chiya Ali kachithekna khapan
kashung thotsai.
ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried,
saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink. He that
believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow
rivers of living water. But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that
believe on him should receive.
pages.tangkhul_content: Phanitwui thang kashung chili Jesu ngakarangda kaho: Mi akhatna khangaraokhalakha Iwui kachungli rada manglu. excerpts.chapter: Chapter 1: Kaphung-kachungwui Tui (The Word in the Beginning)
excerpts.tangkhul_text: Kaphung-kachungwui thotli Tui li-li-sai, kala Tuichi Varivarali lei, kala Tuichi Varivarasai. Chiya kaphung-kachungli Varivarawui kachungli leisai. Ali vangteina ot kathata pamei sakahaisai; Awui chungli haring kasawui maram leisai; kala haring chi miwungwui khanganaso thotsai. Kala Tuichi miwung thot sakahaida i-wui ngachaili pamsai; kala i-thumna Awui mashunkashak theisai.
excerpts.translation_en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made by Him. In Him was life, and the life was the light of men. And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, full of grace and truth.

Jesuna athumli hosa: Tuisin hili tara kaping zang-chihailu. Kala athumna ngathumda kaping zangsai. Phankahai wui pamshim-khararna tara chi khamarao kasada theiphun chitharan, kashak maram mathangsa mana. Kala Varivarawui shimli A se-bing kala tangka kakhalimbingi theida shim katharawui pammali khor-khaleisai.
excerpts.translation_en: On the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus and His disciples were invited. Jesus said unto them: Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them to the brim. When the ruler of the feast tasted the water that was made wine, he knew not whence it was. And in the temple He found those that sold oxen and sheep, and drove them out of the holy place.
